cleavage_agent: Following tissue homogenization and protein extraction, samples containing 10 mg of protein per tissue were digested with trypsin and the resulting peptides fractionated via strong cation exchange chromatography, prior to phosphopeptide enrichment via immobilized metal affinity chromatography.
enrichment_method: Following tissue homogenization and protein extraction, samples containing 10 mg of protein per tissue were digested with trypsin and the resulting peptides fractionated via strong cation exchange chromatography, prior to phosphopeptide enrichment via immobilized metal affinity chromatography.
fractionation_method: Following tissue homogenization and protein extraction, samples containing 10 mg of protein per tissue were digested with trypsin and the resulting peptides fractionated via strong cation exchange chromatography, prior to phosphopeptide enrichment via immobilized metal affinity chromatography.
instrument: Phosphopeptides were analyzed in duplicate via LC-MS/MS on an LTQ-Orbitrap mass spectrometer.
mass_analyzer: Phosphopeptides were analyzed in duplicate via LC-MS/MS on an LTQ-Orbitrap mass spectrometer.
ptm: Each tissue’s unique physiology requires tightly regulated gene and protein expression coordinated by specialized, phosphorylation-dependent intracellular signaling.
